name: Indiana
rateNote: Flat penalty — NOT annualized. Applied to minimum bid amount
keyNotes: 10% penalty is flat — not annualized. You earn 10% if redeemed in month 1 OR month 6
15% if redeemed in months 6–12 — still flat
After 1 year, petition court for tax deed
summary: Indiana holds two annual lien sales: Fall County Tax Sale (Aug-Oct, standard 1-year redemption) and Commissioner's Certificate Sale (unsold parcels, 120-day redemption, lower minimums, less competition). CRITICAL: 10%/15% are FLAT penalties, not annualized — 10% in 6 months = ~20% annualized equivalent. Penalties apply to MINIMUM BID only — overbid earns just 5%/year. Avoid overbidding. After redemption expires, certificate holder must petition Circuit Court for tax deed within 6 months or lien terminates (IC §6-1.1-25-7(a)). 92 counties. Statute: IC §6-1.1-24 (sale), IC §6-1.1-25 (redemption/deeds), IC §6-1.1-25-2 (redemption amount), IC §6-1.1-25-4 (period).
typeWhy: Indiana sells tax lien certificates at two annual sales (Fall and Commissioner's). The investor purchases the lien while the property owner retains title during the 1-year redemption period (120 days for Commissioner's Sale). IC §6-1.1-24.
rateWhy: Indiana uses a tiered flat penalty structure: 10% if the owner redeems within the first 6 months, escalating to 15% for months 7-12. These are FLAT penalties on the minimum bid amount, not annualized interest rates. Overbid earns only 5%/year. IC §6-1.1-25-2.
beginnerTip: Indiana is one of the most beginner-friendly lien states. SRI Tax Sale Services lets you bid from your computer. Start with Marion (Indianapolis) or Hamilton county — good inventory and clear online process.
risks: Overbid earns only 5%/year — avoid overbidding. Penalties apply only to minimum bid amount.
Must petition Circuit Court for tax deed within 6 months after redemption expires or lien terminates (IC §6-1.1-25-7(a))
Check for active drug seizure or civil forfeiture proceedings on the property
IRS 120-day redemption right if notified — easements and governmental liens may survive
ddExtra: Two sales per year: Fall County Tax Sale (Aug-Oct, 1yr redemption) + Commissioner's Certificate Sale (120-day redemption, lower minimums)
Verify no active drug seizure or civil forfeiture on the parcel
Check county DLGF records for any special assessments
Set calendar reminder: must file for deed within 6 months after redemption expires

auctionSignup.platform: SRI Inc. / Zeus Auction (zeusauction.com) — most Indiana counties
steps: Go to zeusauction.com and select Indiana
Create an account and find your target county's upcoming sale
Register online — majority of Indiana counties use SRI's Zeus Auction platform for online bidding
Fund your account via ACH or wire before the auction date
auctionSignup.depositInfo: Varies by county. SRI registration required. Most counties require pre-funding.

otc.note: OTC certificates available from counties after the Fall Sale. Contact county auditor directly. Commissioner's Certificate Sale offers unsold parcels with 120-day redemption.

tylerCompliance.details: This state compliance with Tyler v. Hennepin County (2023) is currently being monitored. Aurigen tracks legislative updates, pending bills, and court decisions that affect tax sale surplus requirements. Check back for updates.

auction.frequency: Annual — September/October (exact date set by county auditor)
auction.bidMethod: Premium bid — highest bidder above minimum
auction.minimumBid: All delinquent taxes + current year taxes due + costs
auction.deed: Certificate of Sale issued to purchaser
auction.note: County auditor/treasurer applies to court for judgment before sale. Electronic auctions also permitted per IC 6-1.1-24-2.

otc.name: Commissioner's Tax Lien Sale / County Executive Sale
otc.trigger: Parcels not sold at county tax sale — county executive acquires lien per IC 6-1.1-24-6
otc.resale: County may resell unsold cert under IC 6-1.1-24-6.1
otc.note: Contact county auditor directly for list of county-held certificates

subTax.name: Subsequent Tax Payment
subTax.rate: 5% per annum on subsequent tax amounts paid
subTax.note: Subsequent taxes paid by cert holder earn 5% — added to redemption amount

redemption.period: 1 year from date of sale (may be extended by court compliance notices)

penalty.afterNotice: 25% if not redeemed after purchaser's IC 6-1.1-25-4.5 notice

redemption.note: Redemption penalty applies to MINIMUM BID only — not the overbid premium. Premium earns 5%/yr separately.

deedPath.name: Tax Deed
deedPath.eligibleAfter: 1 year (plus completion of IC 6-1.1-25-4.5 notice requirements)
deedPath.noticePeriod: Must send certified mail notice within 90 days of sale; 135-day response window given
deedPath.process: Purchaser files petition with county auditor for deed after redemption period + notice compliance
deedPath.note: Deed from county auditor in name of State of Indiana. No warranty. Not always insurable without quiet title.

surplus.name: Tax Sale Surplus Fund
surplus.claimant: Former owner of record at time tax deed issued OR cert purchaser upon redemption
surplus.process: Verified claim to county auditor and treasurer
surplus.note: Surplus held in separate county fund. May also be applied to subsequent tax obligations during redemption period.

es.summary: Indiana realiza dos ventas anuales: Venta de Otoño (octubre) y Venta de Sentencia (enero). Penalización: 10% si se redime en 6 meses, 15% meses 7–12. El exceso de puja gana solo el 5%. Estatuto: IC §6-1.1-24.
es.typeWhy: Indiana es un estado de gravamen porque los condados venden certificados de gravamen fiscal con un período de redención de 1 año (IC §6-1.1-24).
es.rateWhy: La estructura escalonada del 10% si se redime en los primeros 6 meses y 15% en los meses 7-12 incentiva la redención temprana. El exceso de puja gana solo el 5% (IC §6-1.1-24).
es.beginnerTip: Indiana es uno de los estados de gravamen más amigables para principiantes. SRI Tax Sale Services le permite pujar desde su computadora. Comience con Marion (Indianapolis) o Hamilton.
risks: El exceso de puja gana solo el 5% — no sobrepuje
Verifique si el condado realiza Venta de Otoño o Venta de Primavera — no todos realizan ambas
Revise procedimientos activos de confiscación por drogas en la propiedad
ddExtra: Confirme qué tipo de venta está realizando el condado antes de planificar
Verifique que no haya confiscación activa en la parcela
Revise los registros del DLGF del condado para evaluaciones especiales

auctionSignup.platform: SRI Tax Sale Services (sriservices.com) — mayoría de condados de Indiana
steps: Vaya a sriservices.com y seleccione Indiana
Cree una cuenta y encuentre la próxima venta de su condado objetivo
Regístrese en línea — la mayoría de los condados usan SRI para pujas en línea
Financie su cuenta mediante ACH o transferencia antes de la fecha de subasta
auctionSignup.depositInfo: Depósito requerido. Varía por condado. La mayoría requieren fondos anticipados a través de SRI.

otc.note: Certificados OTC disponibles de los condados después de la Venta de Otoño. Contacte al auditor del condado directamente.
